name: defuss-morph
description: Write DOM updates with defuss-morph: morph HTML strings or JSX into the live DOM so focus, typed input and listeners survive; store-driven reactive rendering, refs and forwardRef; defuss-query, defuss-store, defuss-i18n and defuss-dom-router together.

interface.shortDescription: Update the DOM by morphing HTML or JSX, and keep focus, typed input and listeners
interface.longDescription: The defuss-morph skill teaches when and how to morph instead of assigning innerHTML: keyed lists, controlled form state through VNodes, diff mode, transitions, store-driven rendering with reactive(), <Reactive> and df$(selector).reactive(), refs, the forwardRef pattern, and defuss-query, defuss-store, defuss-i18n and defuss-dom-router together.
defaultPrompt: Render this list from a defuss-store store with defuss-morph and keep the typed inputs.
Replace the innerHTML updates in this page with defuss-morph.
Add a component that a parent controls through its ref.
